newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 1c to 588c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 1c to 588c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market edged higher at auctions in Sydney and Adelaide on Tuesday with the eastern market indicator falling 1.0 cent to 588 cents a kg clean, Wool International (WI) said.
In merinos, the 19 micron indicator was slightly dearer but 20/21/22/26m were 0.5 percent cheaper.
The 23m indicator was 0.5 percent dearer and 24/25m unchanged, WI said.
Merino skirtings were up to 2.0 percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27/28/30m were 1.5 percent cheaper, 29m 1.0 percent cheaper and 31m up to 2.0 percent cheaper.
In cardings, locks crutchings were up to 1.0 percent cheaper, WI said.
China provided principal competition with support from Taiwan and Japan, WI said.
Of the 30,887 bales offered, 16.0 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney, Adelaide and Fremantle with about 39,700 bales on offer.
